tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ dharma shwa ra badz+ra ya ga na ma/ bod skad du/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ dpal zung 'jug bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig brjod bral lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /kha sbyor bde chen longs sku gang 'dul shar/ /sku gsum bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos/ /dbang bzhis smin byas dad dang brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi rtag skyo shas nyes dmigs sngon 'gro bas/ /lam mchog 'di la gang gis 'bad gyur na/ /zla drug lo'am tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ /sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ /rmi lam gnyid 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ /'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ /bar do rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'o/ /rang lus thabs ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan/ /shes rab kha kha mu kha'i snyoms 'jug gis/ /zag bcas zag med dga' bzhi rim bzhin no/ /bcud bsdus dag byed stong ra'i gnad gsum dang / /drod myur gtum mo'i chos drug rim bzhin ste/ /ri bong dbab bzung bzlog dgram rlung dang bsre/ /zag med ye shes chen pos brgyan par bya'o/ /gtum mo zas su za ba/ gos su gon pa/ stan du 'ding ba/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba/ gegs rang grol dang / rlung rtar zhon pa'o/ /sgyu lus bden med dbang po rab 'bring gsum/ 'bral med mos gus rang lus cir snang kun/ snang stong zhen bral lha sku'i lam khyer bya/ chags sdang rang grol bcu bzhi'i sa thob 'gyur/ dbang po rab grogs su bla ma dam pa bsten/ 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chad par khrid pa/ tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'o/ /gang gis bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad la 'bral med bya/ /gnyid 'khrul rang dag sgyu ma lam rim gyis/

/yon tan nyin mtshan dus su rang shar 'byung / /rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ spel ba/ sprul ba/ bsgyur ba/ yul snang stong / 'khrul 'byams/ sad 'byams/ bde 'byams/ stong 'byams rnams/ mos gus tshogs gsog gegs sel brgyan par bya/ /'od gsal 'char byed bla ma'i mos gus dang / /bde chen zag bcas zag med lta stangs kyis/ /bde gsal mi rtog dbyer med rang shar 'byung / /sbyor dngos rjes gsum dus gnad brgyan par bya'o/ /'od gsal bzung ba lam khyer/ bsre ba/ mthar thug go /'od gsal mngon gyur dam pa nyams myong can/ /'char sgo bogs 'don gegs sel brgyan par bya/ /'pho ba 'pho byed bral ba yang rab ste/ /'bring dang tha ma chags sdang spangs byas nas/ /dga' zhing mos gus dmigs pa rtse gcig gis/ /gyen du 'phang zhing smon lam brgyan par bya/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yid dam gyi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o/ /dus gnad/ lus gnad/ rdzas gnad/ sbyang zhing brtan pas 'pho ba mchog yin no/ /bar do snang sogs 'od gsal chos sku dang / /gang 'dul sprul sku mtshams sbyor skyo shas gnad/ /chags sdang phrag dog 'od gsal lha skus sbyang / /dus der sgrib gnyis rang dag sku gsum mngon du gyur/ rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar/ tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar/ spyi gnad 'chug med lam khyer ro/ /gzugs sgras chu snang mched la sogs pa yi/ /thim 'gros rang bzhin brgyad cu shes par bya'o/ /log bltas rgyud dkrugs rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus/ /yang dag chos ni nyin skar rus sbal spu/ /log chos tshong 'dus 'o ma'i chos spyod tshe/ /nyams myong lung dang thim yig brgyan pa gces/ /lam gyi mchog gyur 'di nyid nyams len rnams/ /gzhan gyi dus min 'di'am bar ma dor/ /bde stong dbyer med sku gnyis rang shar nas/

/rnam par dag pa'i mkha' spyod nyid du 'gro/ /'di nyid mi rabs bdun du chig rgyud las/ /mi spel rdo rje'i rgya yis gdab par bya'o/ /chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba brlan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te nyams su myong bar byas so/ /phyis tho ling du lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos gtan la phab pa'o// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i tshig gsal bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la/ /gus lus ngag yid gsum btud chos drug rdo rje'i tshig /ma nor mkha' 'gro'i ni gu ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /'di mos pa'i gang zag gzhan rnams la phan phyir dgod bya ba/ /de la rdo rje 'chang gis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma la gsungs pa'i snyan rgyud zhal gyi gdams pa 'di la drug ste/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar dang / sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol dang / rmi lam gnying 'khrul rang dag dang / 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs dang / 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas dang / bar do rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i/ sku'o/ /dang po thabs lam la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes so/ /dang po sngon 'gro la gsum ste/ sdig sgrib dag byed a'i stong ra/ stong ra sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad/ nad gdon sel byed rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par sel bar byed pa ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ lus gnad me'i stong ra dang / gtum mo zas su za ba dang / gos su gon pa dang / gdan du 'dings pa dang / srid pa'i dbang zhu ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes la gnyis te/ gegs rang grol dang / rlung rtar zhon pa'o/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus la gsum ste/ dbang po rab grogs su bla ma dam pa bsten pa 'bral med du/

'bring tshig gtam la sogs pa gzhan gyis bar ma chad par khrid pa dang / tha ma mal gcig tu yengs med du bsgoms pas rgyud la ting nge 'dzin skyes pa'o/ /dang po dbang rab la gnyis te/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs shing cir snang thams cad bla ma'i lam khyer/ cir snang thams cad bden med du lam du khyer ro/ /gnyis pa dbang po 'bring la yang gnyis ste/ rang lus snang stong lha sku dbyer med/ cir snang thams cad sgyu ma'i rmi lam lam khyer ro/ /gsum pa dbang po tha ma la bzhi ste/ 'gro drug sgyu mar thams cad bden med du 'char bar byed/ pa'i chos 'byung bsgoms pa dang / /nad gdon thams cad sgyu ma'i rmi lam du lam du khyer ba dang / 'char drod sgyu ma rang shar byed rmi lam zang zing yon tan tshogs drug /zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ro/ /gsum pa rmi lam la drug ste/ rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ spel ba/ sprul ba/ sgyur ba/ yul snang ngo / gtan la dbab po/ dang po rmi lam bzung ba la gnyis te/ rang zin pa/ 'chug med do/ /dang po rang zin ni/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad do/ /gnyis pa gnad 'chug med la dgu ste/ dus kyi gnad gsum tho rang zhogs pas nyi ma shar ba'o/ lus kyi gnas gsum dkyil dkrung tsog pu seng ge'i nyal thabs/ dmigs pa'i gnad gsum mo rtog med dang gnyis rtog bcas so/ /gnyis pa sbyang ba la bzhi ste/ sems kyis lus sbyang ba dang / lus kyis sems sbyang ba dang / bdag med mas sbyang ba dang / 'dun pas sbyang ba'o/ /gsum pa spel ba la gnyis te/ thug 'phrad du spel ba dang / gang 'dul du spel ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ 'byung ba'i phra ba la spel ba dang / rags pa la spel ba dang / sems can phra ba la spel ba dang / rags pa la spel ba'o/ /gnyis pa gang 'dul la gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul gcan ga zan seng ge bya khyi stag la sogs pa dang /

'das pa'i khro bo dang khyung la sogs pa gang 'dul lo/ /bzhi pa sprul pa yang de bzhin no/ /lnga pa bsgyur ba la yang bzhi ste/ 'byung bzhi phra rags su bsgyur ba dang / sems can phra rags su bsgyur ba dang / lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba dang / snang sku de rnams thams cad stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba'o/ /drug pa yul snang la bzhi ste/ dbang po rab dmigs med gsal mkhyen/ 'bring gang bsams gsal mthong / tha ma yid lus mkha' lding dang khyung / dman pa dmigs pa'i yul snang ngo / /de la gsum ste/ bdag med ma yul snang 'char byed/ a yul snang rang gsal/ thig le yul snang gsal byed do/ /bzhi pa 'od gsal la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po sngon 'gro la bzhi ste/ rtsa ba 'chi ba mi rtag dang skyo shas bskyed pa'o/ /yal ga spyod lam dam rdzas dam la kha zas snum pa ka pa la ru gtor ma/ lo 'dab tshogs dang thabs lam bsgoms pa rang sangs/ rigs pa/ bla ma'i me tog gsol 'debs kyi 'od gsal 'char byed do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi ste 'od gsal bzung ba dang / lam khyer dang / bsre ba dang / mthar thug gi rang shar gyi 'od gsal lo/ /dang po bzung ba la dgu ste/ nyi shar tho rangs nam langs pa dus kyi gnad gsum/ lus kyi dkyil dkrung tsog pu seng ge'i nyal thabs/ gnad gsum/ dmigs pa'i gnad gsum a'i bdag med ma bla ma'i mo/ /gnyis pa lam khyer la gnyis te/ nyin par sku gsum lam khyer/ rmi lam du mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ro/ /gsum pa la bsre ba la bzhi ste/ gsal stong bde chen du bsre ba dang nyin mtshan dbyer med du bsre ba dang / lta stangs glang po che'i kyi mnyam bzhag dang rjes su bsre ba dang / shes rab ma'i bde ba bde stong du dbyer med du bsre ba'o/

/bzhi pa mthar thug gi 'od gsal la lnga ste/ gsal stong rang shar gyi 'od gsal dang / bde stong rang shar gyi 'od gsal dang / zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od 'dus ma byas dang gsal/ dbyer med mthar bde gsal mi rtog gsum thug gi 'od gsal dang / dag pa nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag pa'i gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal lo/ /gsum pa la lnga ste/ dam tshig spyi dang bye brag rtsa ba dang yan lag gi thig le'o/ /gegs sel nyes skyon rang grol dang / bogs 'don the tshom gcod byed dang / khyad 'phags 'char 'od gsal gyis sgo ngos 'dzin/ nyams rtogs 'od gsal dang nyin mtshan gnyis kyi khyad par ro/ /lnga pa 'pho ba la bzhi ste/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba dang / gzugs sku zung 'jug gi gsal stong bde stong 'pho ba dang / byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba dang / 'chug med mkha' dkar dmar spyod kyi 'pho ba'o/ /drug pa bar do la bzhi ste/ dbang po rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar ba dang / tha ma sprul sku 'chug med rang shar dang / spyi gnad 'chug med lam khyer ro/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa rnams/ mdo dang rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/ /rang gis nyams su myong byas nas/ /yid kyi lung gis brgyan par bya'o/ /chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang las khyung po rnal 'byor pa bdag gis/ cung zhig gsal bar byas pa'o rdzogs so/ /rdo rje 'chang gis bde drod bde stong gsungs pa yi/ chos drug bye brag thems yig 'di/ sngon thabs lam 'gro dag byed stong ra la/ /gsol bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib ting nge 'dzin/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon sel ba'o/ 'debs gsum la dmigs pa gsum/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar la/ /gsol 'debs gnyis la dmigs pa lnga/ me'i stong ra zas su za ba gos su gyon pa gdan du 'ding pa rlung rtar zhon pa/

/dbang po rab dang 'bring po la/ gsol 'debs lnga la dmigs pa 'dun pa gsum bdag 'dzin dgos med sgyu lus 'od gsal rmi lam/ sgyu lus dbang po tha ma la/ /gsol 'debs gsum la 'dun pa gsum/ 'chi nges pa bla ma'i mos gus sgyu ma rmi lam yin snyam pa/ rmi lam 'dzin par byed pa la/ gsol 'debs gsum la 'dun pa bdag 'dzin dgos med rmi lam zin pa gsum/ rmi lam sbyang ba'i chos bzhi la/ gsol 'debs lus dang sems bdag med 'dun bzhi la dmigs pa bzhi bdag 'dzin dgos med sgyu lus rmi lam zin pa/ rmi lam spel ba'i chos drug la/ gsol 'debs bzhi la 'byung bzhi phra ba rags pa sems can phra ba rags pa 'dzin pa dang 'das pa'i gang 'dul 'dun pa drug /rmi lam sprul ba'i chos drug la/ /gsol 'debs 'dun pa de bzhin no/ /rmi lam bsgyur ba'i chos bzhi la/ /gsol 'debs bdag 'dzin dgos med yul snang / bzhi la 'dun pa bzhi 'byung bzhi phra rags sems can phra rags lha sku sna tshogs snang stong zhen med du sgyur ba'o/ /sgyu lus gdan thog gcig ma la/ 'chi nges pa mos gus gnyid du song bar 'dug rmi lam du 'dug sbyang spel sprul bsgyur/ gsol 'debs bzhi la 'dun pa brgyad/ /yul snang dmigs pa rnam gsum la/ /gsol 'debs gsum bdag 'dzin dgos med yul snang la dmigs pa gsum bdag med ma la thig le/ khyad 'phags 'bras bu 'od gsal chos bzhi la/ /gsol 'debs gsum bdag 'dzin dgos med 'od gsal la dmigs pa bzhi/ 'od gsal bzung ba lam khyer bsre ba mthar thug 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas la/ /gsol 'debs bdag 'dzin dgos med bar do sangs rgyas gsum la dmigs pa bzhi/ chos sku gzugs sku bla ma mkha' spyod/ bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku la/ /gsol 'debs bdag 'dzin dgos med bar dor gsum la dmigs pa bzhi rab 'bring tha ma spyi gnad/

/gsol 'debs bla ma'i dang dmigs pa'i thems yig chos drug 'di/ /'chug med gnad du shes par bya'o/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis drug pa/ ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma la gsungs pa yi ni gu ma la/ /snyan rgyud 'di mi rabs bdun du chig rgyud chos drug 'di la/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bsre slad byas nas tshong 'dus gyi 'o mar song ba/ /de dus khrid lugs sna tshogs bas 'byung / /dad ldan rnams the tshom dang yid gnyis spang ba'i phyir/ /'chug med gnad kyi thems yig bkod/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol de la gnas nas zhing las sngags rnams kyi/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang / thems yig dang bcas pa 'di/ ḍa ki mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du/ bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas yi ger bkod pa'o/ /ྀatsha/ ༈ gzhi lam 'bras gsum ni/ gzhi dbang bzhi rdzogs/ lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'bras bu sku bde chen 'phrin las lhun grub phyogs med rang shar ro/ /gnad drug chos drug ni/ thabs lam rtsol ba'i gnad/ sgyu lus bden med kyi gnad/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad/ 'od gsal mos gus kyi gnad/ 'pho ba dmigs pa rtse gcig gi gnad/ bar do skyo shas kyi gnad do/ /gegs drug chos drug ni/ thabs lam drod rtsol ba chung ba/ sgyu lus la 'thas de bzhin du/ rmi lam la 'byams gcig gnyis su gol ba/ 'od gsal brdugs mos gus chung ba/ 'pho ba rtog pa sna tshogs su la 'phros/ bar do la 'khrul pa'o tha mal du/ lta ba/ sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu ni/ /lta ba phyogs med mtha' bral zung 'jug bsgom pa gsal stong gsal bde chen stong 'dzin med/ dam tshig rang sems rnam dag /spyod pa blang dor rang grol/ 'bras bu sku gsum rang shar/ phrin las phyogs med lhun grub pa'o/

/yang gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ni/ byin brlabs dbang bzhi/ gtum mo lam gyi bogs 'don/ rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin/ 'od gsal 'bras bur 'char ba'o/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu sku gsum ni/ gzhi sku gsum rang shar/ lam sku gsum lam khyer/ 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur/ phrin las lhun grub phyogs med do/ /ḍa ki mas seng ldeng nags kyi nam mkha' la gsungs so/ /rdzogs so/ /rdo rje 'chang gis ḍa ki ne gu ma la gsungs/ des khyung po rnal 'byor pa la gsungs/ des smog lcog pa la/ des skyer sgang pa la/ des sangs rgyas snyan ston la/ des sangs rgyas ston pa la/ des shangs ston/ des mus pa rgyal mtshan dpal la/ des rgyal ba rin po che la/ des mkhas grub nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la/ des bdag rgyal mtshan bla ma la'o/ /rgyal ba'i yum bar pa las/ grogs dag mir skye ba ni dkon/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa ni nyung / sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni dkon/ 'khor ba las thar ba ni dkon/ de ltar yin gyis dal ba chud gson par ma byed cig phyis mi khom par 'gyur cing / phyis gsor mi rung bar gyur ta re ces gsungs so// //maṅgalaṃ bha wan+tu// //shubhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rgyal mtshan bla mas mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
